notes.title: Patch #3 - July 28th 2025
notes.content:
[p]Hi Crown Gambit players,   Welcome to version 1.0.6 - this patch fixes a list of various bugs:[/p][h3]
Continuity errors:[/h3][list][*][p]Continuity Rupture when choosing to support Havrok in chapter 15[/p][/*][*][p]Siding with Gallenore on Chapter 15 resulted in siding with Havrok if a serment was made to Karv [/p][/*][*][p]Foiling scheme against Neantis in chapter 5a caused the game to act as if we don’t know about the scheme (making the gargoil fight impossible to get) [/p][/*][*][p]Neantis could be fought while interned in Wace Asylum in chapter 16 [/p][/*][*][p]Gwinblenn can be fought multiple times in chapters 15/16/17[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Missing assets & punctuation errors:[/h3][list][*][p]Neantis introduction cutscene missing in chapter 15[/p][/*][*][p]Missing Hael portrait in chapter Thulder[/p][/*][*][p]Missing Rollo portrait in chapter Thulder[/p][/*][*][p]Missing Hael portrait in chapter Amaister[/p][/*][*][p]Missing Rollo portrait in chapter Illioze[/p][/*][*][p]Spaces before interrogation marks in German version[/p][/*][*][p]Missing non-breaking spaces in French version[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Softlocks:[/h3][list][*][p]Yster’s Circular Attack softlocked when targeting all Paladins and one of them had Dodge[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch #2 - July 7th 2025
notes.content:
[p]Hi Crown Gambit players! Thank you again for all the feedback you provided! [/p][p][/p][p][b]What was fixed: [/b][/p][list][*][p]Missing intro combat cutscene for Karmine and Havrok in chapters 15/16/17[/p][/*][*][p]Some dialogue incoherences[/p][/*][*][p]Missing portraits in some dialogues[/p][/*][*][p]Spelling errors[/p][/*][*][p]Cropped lines in decision phases[/p][/*][*][p]Visual glitch with Pure Acid[/p][/*][*][p]Missing trigger for Incorruptible achievement [/p][/*][*][p]Not working disable screenshake setting[/p][/*][*][p]Missing keyword highlight in Hunan passive[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]What was added: [/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]A new button to skip dialogues faster[/p][/*][*][p]Improved VFX performances (which should hopefully minimize crashes)[/p][/*][*][p]New accessibilty feature: disable camera panning when screenshake is disabled[/p][/*][*][p]Inventory access during level up is now available[/p][/*][*][p]Ancestral Grace feature after chapter 2 is forced. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We hope this new patch improves your experience and, as always, will read your feedback thoroughly! 

The Crown Gambit team. [/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: New patch - June 24th 2025
notes.content:
[p]Here is the list of everything that was fixed:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Crash in card duplication interface when less than 5 duplicable cards available[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Combat might block if the hero has duplicate cards[/p][/*][*][p]Crash when reaching dialogue choices in German[/p][/*][*][p]It was possible to cheat card duplication when using controller[/p][/*][*][p]Voyage altar duplication card title was written in French[/p][/*][*][p]Game softlocks when dialogue has a background error[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]And for those of you who got a bit... Rocked by our handsome Hermet, we have balanced his damages.

He has a message for you - things are sometimes heavy in Meodred and one might lose their temper easily... [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241911/48d5560786c40022c647382c0d38b8e3278617c2.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Crown Gambit is coming to Steam June 18th 2025!
notes.content:
We are excited to share the news:  Crown Gambit will be released on PC and Mac this Summer on June 18th 2025. You've never been so close to exploring the kingdom of Meodred and getting the answers to your questions: 

- Who killed the king? 
- Which heir will succeed to the throne?
- What secrets does Meodred hold? 

While we wait to discover the mysteries of Crown Gambit's story, check out our trailer!

[previewyoutube=tYMW9DfpgvI;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Crown Gambit is coming to PC Summer 2025! ⚔️
notes.content:
As announced during Future Games Show Spring, Crown Gambit gets a release period: Summer 2025! 

Can't wait for release? You can still enjoy the demo until March 31st and wishlist the game to support Crown Gambit! 

[previewyoutube=7fOeKNm68OA;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]DEMO FEATURES
[/b]
[list]
[*] Revised tutorial phase, 
[*] New game intro, 
[*] New interface and travel phases 
[*] Reworked balancing for Ancestral Grace gameplay mechanics and combat systems  
[*] New choices and dialogues
[/list]

Explore the first two chapters of Crown Gambit entirely in an updated demo. 
The kingdom of Meodred's tenuous balance of power is being shaken to its core after the king's assassination and mysterious forces seem to be pulling strings from the dark. 
Experience the beginning of our three heroes' journey, make the right choices to guide their path, find the assassin, and take the young Prince to safety in the capital! 
Encounter your first boss battle and discover the Ancestral Grace mechanic: channel board-shattering strength through ancient relics to defeat your enemies. Beware not to lose your soul though…

notes.title: Crown Gambit is coming to Steam in 2025!
notes.content:
[b]It's official : Crown Gambit will be published by Playdigious Originals, and set to launch next year.
[/b]
In Crown Gambit, dive into a gripping tactical RPG where every decision shapes the future of a kingdom torn by a brutal war of succession. Take command of three fearless paladins, choose alliances among noble families, and engage in strategic card-based combat to secure your place.

[h3]To get a glimpse of the epic journey that awaits, watch the two new trailers here! 👑⚔️
[/h3]

[previewyoutube=vRf8vX62bV8;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=LNDfMAzypjY;full][/previewyoutube]

Mark your calendar: Crown Gambit is coming in 2025! Stay tuned for more updates and wishlist the game now to be among the first to experience this medieval adventure.
